title: Context-intelligence Unit C: canonical versioned deterministic subsystem/ontology resolver (D-013)
objective: Define the missing subsystem mapping deterministically and version it BEFORE any memory digest may reference it; closed vocabulary derived from existing paths/symbols/requirements/tasks/directives/milestones only (no second free-form taxonomy); no LLM parent selection.
business_reason: D-013 Unit C; prerequisite of Unit D (memory graph).
inputs: tools/repo_index_incremental.py build_incremental + tools/code_graph/query.py GraphIndex (accepted A1/A2 index, consumed read-only in process)
project-control/master_plan.json, project-control/tasks/*.json, project-control/directives/*/ (authoritative entity indexes, read-only)
D-013 requirements R008/R009/R018/R028/R043/R044/R045/R046 (closed vocabulary, no LLM parents, honest graph kinds, version binding, two-pass)
outputs: tools/subsystem_map.json — versioned closed-vocabulary mapping file (ordered longest-prefix rules whose subsystem ids ARE existing repo path prefixes; map_version + canonical digest)

tools/subsystem_resolver.py — versioned deterministic resolver (map load/validate fail-closed, path→subsystem longest-prefix resolution, RESOLVER_VERSION + map digest export, bounded CLI + --check determinism proof)

tools/subsystem_entities.py — deterministic entity existence validation against authoritative indexes (task/requirement/directive/milestone/file/graph-node) + the two-pass extract→resolve API with unresolved_links reasons
tools/test_subsystem_resolver.py — executable AS-1..AS-6 acceptance tests + edge cases
docs/SUBSYSTEM_ONTOLOGY.md — ontology doc: derivation rules, versioning, honest statement of ACTUAL code-graph node/edge kinds (subsystem is a resolver-layer bucket, never a graph node)

acceptance_scenarios.when: the resolver loads and validates it against the current repository tree
acceptance_scenarios.then: every subsystem id IS an existing repo-relative directory prefix (closed vocabulary = existing paths, no free-form taxonomy names anywhere); a map rule naming a nonexistent prefix fails validation with a machine-readable reason (D-013-R008)

the resolution output is byte-identical and stamps resolver_version, map_version, and map_digest (sha256 over canonical map bytes) so downstream fingerprints and memory digests can bind the ontology version (D-013-R028/R044)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a repo file path, a task id, and a requirement id
acceptance_scenarios.then: every parent is DERIVED deterministically — path→subsystem via ordered longest-prefix rules; task→milestone via the task packet + master plan; requirement→directive via the directives registry — with zero model involvement in any structural decision (D-013-R009/R045)

acceptance_scenarios.given: extraction proposals that include a nonexistent path, task id, and requirement id alongside valid ones
acceptance_scenarios.when: the deterministic resolver pass runs over the proposals
acceptance_scenarios.then: each valid proposal receives a validated structural link and each invalid one lands in unresolved_links[] with a machine-readable reason; nothing is guessed, invented, or silently dropped (two passes: extraction proposes, resolver validates/derives — D-013-R046)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the accepted A1/A2 deterministic index export
acceptance_scenarios.then: it enumerates the ACTUAL node and edge kinds present in the export, labels subsystem as a resolver-layer mapping, and asserts the graph itself defines no subsystem node kind; graph bytes are never modified (D-013-R018)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a malformed map, an unknown map_version, or an unreadable authoritative index
acceptance_scenarios.then: the resolver refuses with a nonzero exit and a machine-readable reason — never a silent default vocabulary and never a partial answer presented as complete (fail closed, D-013-R013-style)

risks: Vocabulary drift: a committed enumerated map can go stale when directories move; mitigated by validating every rule prefix against the live tree at load (fail closed) and versioning the map
Scope creep into Unit D: this unit establishes the resolver + versions only; NO memory digests, NO session-memory schema implementation (D-013-R043 sequencing, R066-style boundary)
path_free_justification: Paths bound at claim (2026-08-18) after M0-T065 acceptance, per the D-013 sequencing reservation (source-002). New versioned deterministic subsystem resolver (map + resolver + entity validation + tests + doc); no existing module is rewritten.
